caption: Time runs left to right in days. The buyer's 1 ETH sits in the contract until the confirm on day 3, when the whole deposit moves to the seller and the contract balance drops to 0 ETH; the 7-day deadline is never crossed, so the refund path stays closed.

spec.aria: Timeline in days for a 1 ETH escrow: the contract holds 1 ETH from day 0, the buyer confirms on day 3, the full 1 ETH is paid to the seller, the contract balance becomes 0 ETH, and the refund path stays closed through the 7-day deadline.
